title: Chat with your PDFs (RAG with citations)
tagline: Upload PDFs, ask questions, and get streamed answers where every claim links to the exact page it came from.
problem: Answers from a document chat are only useful if you can check them. Most retrieval demos cite nothing, or cite a whole file.
built: Hybrid vector and BM25 retrieval fused with reciprocal rank fusion, Claude's native citations mapped back to page and quote, Server-Sent Events streaming, and a click-to-page viewer that highlights the cited passage. One docker compose up runs the whole stack, and a mock provider runs it without an API key.
highlights: Eval on a 20-question golden set: recall@8 100%, faithfulness 5.0/5, about $0.001 per question
Prompt caching on follow-up turns; nothing is persisted when a stream fails
FastAPI + PyMuPDF + Chroma back end, React + react-pdf front end
60 pytest, 44 Vitest and Playwright smoke tests in CI
testing: 60 pytest and 44 Vitest tests plus a Playwright smoke run on every push, and a 20-question golden-set eval that reports retrieval recall, citation accuracy, faithfulness, latency and cost.
